instruction: I'm getting "command not found" when trying to use 'java' even though I have Java installed. Could you help me set the JAVA_HOME environment variable in my shell configuration to /usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting JAVA_HOME environment variable in .bashrc to fix Java command issues. Evaluator checks if JAVA_HOME line exists in .bashrc. Same pattern as original - fixing command not found by configuring environment variables.

Export keyword verified: The pattern '^\s*export\s+JAVA_HOME\s*=...' correctly requires the 'export' keyword, ensuring the variable will be available to child processes
Appropriate flexibility: The pattern allows reasonable formatting variations (optional quotes, whitespace, comments) while maintaining correctness
Minor issue: Pattern allows mismatched quotes (e.g., "path' or 'path"), but this is unlikely to occur in practice and would likely fail at shell execution anyway
